description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pitipana South, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520007 (23/55015)
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and the subsequent registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
